# Hasher deterministic seeding

Started work in `/app`. Repository status was clean. `rg` is unavailable, so local searches will use `grep`/`find`.

Implemented exported `Hasher`, package and instance `SetSeed`, seed restoration, automatic initialization, and synchronized seed map access. A process-wide `maphash.Seed` makes explicitly seeded hashes match across `Hasher` instances in the same process. Added regression tests for restoration, package-level assignment, cross-instance agreement, and automatic initialization.

Checks passed:
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test ./utils/hasher ./db ./persistence`
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off go test -race ./utils/hasher`
- `git diff --check`

The initial `rg` search could not run because `rg` is not installed; searches used `find` and `grep` instead. The process-wide `maphash.Seed` is randomized at process startup, so numeric hash values are not guaranteed to match across process restarts.

diff --git a/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go b/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
index 3127f78..d2394da 100644
--- a/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
+++ b/utils/hasher/hasher_test.go
@@ -40,4 +40,43 @@ var _ = Describe("HashFunc", func() {
 		Expect(sum).To(Equal(hashFunc("1", input)))
 		Expect(sum2).To(Equal(hashFunc("2", input)))
 	})
+
+	It("restores a hash when a previous seed is set again", func() {
+		h := hasher.NewHasher()
+		hashFunc := h.HashFunc()
+		h.SetSeed("id", "original")
+		original := hashFunc("id", input)
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).To(Equal(original))
+
+		h.Reseed("id")
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).NotTo(Equal(original))
+
+		h.SetSeed("id", "original")
+		Expect(hashFunc("id", input)).To(Equal(original))
+	})
+
+	It("uses the same hash for the same id and seed across hashers", func() {
+		first := hasher.NewHasher()
+		second := hasher.NewHasher()
+		first.SetSeed("id", "shared")
+		second.SetSeed("id", "shared")
+		Expect(first.HashFunc()("id", input)).To(Equal(second.HashFunc()("id", input)))
+	})
+
+	It("applies a seed set through the package function", func() {
+		hashFunc := hasher.HashFunc()
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test", "saved")
+		original := hashFunc("global-test", input)
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test", "changed")
+		Expect(hashFunc("global-test", input)).NotTo(Equal(original))
+		hasher.SetSeed("global-test", "saved")
+		Expect(hashFunc("global-test", input)).To(Equal(original))
+	})
+
+	It("initializes a seed on the first hash", func() {
+		h := hasher.NewHasher()
+		hashFunc := h.HashFunc()
+		first := hashFunc("new-id", input)
+		Expect(hashFunc("new-id", input)).To(Equal(first))
+	})
 })
